description: Stereo frequency shifter after the Moog and Bode module: every frequency moves by the same number of Hz rather than by an interval, so harmonics land out of tune

params.text: Sets the shift by hand, -5 to 5, added to the voltage at the CV jack

inputs.text: The left audio to be shifted
Sets the shift, -5V for the largest downward shift and 5V for the largest upward one, added to the SHIFT AMT knob, despite the maker's tooltip naming it Disorder
The right audio to be shifted

outputs.text: The left channel shifted downwards, which can fold frequencies below zero and produce a lot of subsonic energy
The right channel shifted downwards, which can fold frequencies below zero and produce a lot of subsonic energy

notes: the RANGE control is a button rather than a right-click menu: clicking it drops down a list of 5 Hz, 50 Hz, 500 Hz, 5 kHz and exp, and the setting it holds is the span of the shift
a range of 5 Hz means 5 Hz down at the bottom of the shift control and 5 Hz up at the top, and the exp setting runs 2Hz to 2000Hz at a volt per octave instead
there is no anti-aliasing, so shifting up until the highest input frequency plus the shift passes half the sample rate will alias
